subject: Next steps: SIG kickoff + legacy IP / on-prem connector questions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@legacytech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: SIG kickoff + legacy IP / on-prem connector questions

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about the migration work you have planned and the latency-sensitive inference paths for your on-prem agents. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Redwood fit: Hosted API for dev/test + dedicated/private for production (we discussed private VPC option for regulated workflows).
- Security posture: you mentioned SOC 2 evidence is required and that you have HIPAA concerns for a subset of the workloads.
- Immediate ask: you asked for the SIG (or CAIQ) initiation and a short checklist we can complete to speed procurement.

Before I kick off the formal SIG prefill with our security team, two clarifying questions from my side that will change the evidence set we provide: 
1) Data residency: will production inference traffic stay in AWS us-east-1 for now, or do you require EU residency for any tenant data?
2) Legacy IP / on-prem connectors: you referenced an internal 'legacy enrichment' connector that routes third-party PII into a preprocessing service — will Redwood ever receive raw third-party data pulled by that connector, or is preprocessing done entirely inside your network?

If you prefer, we can start with a lightweight SIG prefill (answers we control + pointer to SOC 2 summary) and expand if you need deeper on-prem evidence or architecture diagrams. Attached is a short SIG intro and our SOC 2 summary for context.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm answers to Q1–Q2 (above)
- I open the SIG prefill and drop a prefilling template for your security team to review (I attached it as well)
- If you want vendor references or a short privacy addendum, we can loop Legal — Jordan, can you be on standby if they ask for contract redlines?

Thanks — hope the attachments help. Happy to jump on another quick call with your security lead if that speeds things up.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: redwood_sig_intro.pdf (1.2MB), redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (420KB), sig-prefill-template.xlsx (12KB)

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@legacytech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Reed <devon.reed@legacytech.com>, procurement@legacytech.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SIG kickoff + legacy IP / on-prem connector questions

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the summary and the materials — helpful. Quick answers below: 

1) Data residency: production inference for EU customers must stay in eu-west-1. We have a mix of tenants; for now we’ll need evidence that you support EU residency (or a plan to restrict EU-only tenants to eu-west-1).

2) Legacy connector: preprocessing (PII redaction and enrichment) is performed in our internal network by the connector. However, there are two legacy flows where raw payloads are forwarded to third-party transformers; we want to be sure Redwood will never store or retain those raw payloads.

A note on SOC 2: we do require a Type II report (within last 12 months) as part of procurement. We can accept a bridge letter if there’s a gap, but the full report is preferred.

Procurement: Devon on cc will handle the procurement timeline and will send our standard security SOP for vendor onboarding. Devon, expected procurement window and required SLAs?

Thanks — happy to have our security architect hop on a call with Karthik if you want to walk through architecture specifics.

—Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of Security | LegacyTech Systems
aisha.khan@legacytech.com | +1 (617) 555-3344

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@legacytech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SIG kickoff + legacy IP / on-prem connector questions

Thanks Aisha — that helps a lot. A few follow-ups so we can scope the SIG correctly: 

- EU residency: we support region-pinning for customer data. For the SIG prefill I’ll call out eu-west-1 hosting and include our deployment options. If you need an explicit data processing addendum (DPA) clause for EU-only tenants, Jordan can take point.

- Raw payloads: we do not retain user-uploaded raw payloads by default; our runtime streams and holds KV cache for active sessions but we can propose a no-persist policy for the affected workflows. For completeness, can you confirm whether the two legacy flows that forward raw payloads are initiating outbound calls from your network (i.e., Redwood receives only transformed payloads) or whether there are any inbound pushes to Redwood that would include raw content?

- SOC 2: we have a Type II covering 2025 (report issued Mar 2026). I’ve attached a redacted summary earlier but we can provide the full report under an NDA. Jordan — please confirm readiness to share full report to Aisha under NDA and anyone on procurement.

Proposed immediate action: I’ll open the SIG prefill with a set of answers we can control (hosting, encryption-at-rest/TLS, SOC 2 availability) and point out the two items (raw payload retention + EU DPA) that will need your confirmation. Karthik — can you review the prefills for any technical gaps I might miss?

If that sounds good I’ll submit the prefill today and mark the two items as 'awaiting customer confirmation' so your team can see outstanding asks.

Best,
Soojin

> > Thanks for the summary and the materials — helpful. Quick answers below...

From: Devon Reed <devon.reed@legacytech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@legacytech.com>
Cc: procurement@legacytech.com, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SIG kickoff + legacy IP / on-prem connector questions

Soojin / Aisha —

Procurement timeline: target decision by end of September (we're running an internal Q3 approval window). Required SLAs: 99.9% monthly uptime, documented incident escalation, and a data processing addendum for EU data. We will need the full SOC 2 Type II (redacted acceptable) uploaded to our vendor portal — I can share the link.

Security asks from our side before procurement sign-off:
- Full SOC 2 Type II (or bridge letter + SOC roadmap if issuance gap)
- Confirmation of EU-only tenant isolation (region pinning)
- Written policy confirming non-persistence of raw payloads and options for no-persist runtime (if feasible)
- List of sub-processors and any third-party transformers Redwood integrates with

Also, please include two recent vendor references we can contact (preferably a mid-market customer with similar on-prem connectors).

Devon Reed
Senior Procurement Manager | LegacyTech Systems
procurement@legacytech.com

Attachments referenced: procurement-vendor-onboard-sop.pdf (from LegacyTech)
